claim_one_line: LISTENING 10, OMEGA'S OWN SYMMETRY (PROVED, exact; data-free): the reading (3, 3, 3) the whole selects is fixed by the move LR^-1, which acts on every reading as the cyclic exchange (x, y, z) -> (y, z, x), of order 3; at the common point it is a third turn about (1, 1, 1), the diagonal the whole opens along, with eigenvalues 1, e^(2 pi i/3), e^(-2 pi i/3) on the triplet: omega's symmetry tells the three apart, one neutral and two with conjugate charges; it fixes the positive lift and cycles the other three
